/bin/bash -lc 'root=MainProjects/Algebraic-Jacobian-Challenge-Rebuild
"$HORIZON_GIT" ls-tree -r --name-only HEAD -- "$root/AlgebraicJacobian" "$root/AlgebraicJacobian.lean" |
while IFS= read -r p; do
  if test ! -e "$p"; then
    printf '"'D\\t%s\\n' \""'$p"
  else
    h=$("$HORIZON_GIT" rev-parse "HEAD:$p")
    d=$("$HORIZON_GIT" hash-object "$p")
    if test "$h" != "$d"; then
      printf '"'M\\t%s\\tHEAD=%s\\tDISK=%s\\n' \""'$p" "$h" "$d"
    fi
  fi
done'
